lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\HtmlViewer\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
2 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Listeners/CSPListener.php:72 OCP\AppFramework\Http\EmptyContentSecurityPolicy::allowEvalScript(): deprecated since Nextcloud 17, Nextcloud 33 is the last major to have it; Eval should not be used anymore. Please update your scripts. This function will stop functioning in a future version of Nextcloud.
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated and that Nextcloud 36 no longer has: the app fails on the first major without it, once it declares that one.

Please update your scripts. This function will stop functioning in a future version of Nextcloud.

psalm/phar, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

The app reads and writes its app config in 9 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
